sourceText:
Sweet Macaroni Side
By: Lady Catherine ...
Published: Wednesday, September 18, 2013 - 11:54am

Ingredients




16 oz. cottage cheese
¼ cup brown sugar
1 cup milk
½ cup fresh basil
¼ cup orange marmalade
½ cup plain or vanilla yogurt
1 lb. favorite macaroni or noodles
Crumb Topping:
1¼ cups flour
½ cup brown sugar
¼ cup granulated sugar
½ tsp. cinnamon
¼ tsp. salt
1 stick butter

Preparation

1 Prepare macaroni or noodles as directed; drain and set aside. 2 In a food processor combine the first 6 ingredients and process until smooth. 3 Butter a baking pan and place the macaroni in the pan.  Pour the ingredients from the food processor and toss. 4 Crumb Topping: 5 Combine all of the above ingredients in a bowl and crumble with your fingers until small pieces form. 6 Prepare the crumb topping.   Stir half of the topping into the noodles and the other half cover the top of noodles with. 7 Preheat Oven 350 degrees: 8 Bake 25-30 minutes.
